tagline: Wood-fired pizza & Italian street food in Offerton, Stockport.
storyText:
La Cucina Povera — 'the poor kitchen' — is a wood-fired pizza kitchen and Italian street food operation in Offerton. Pizzas made to order at Woodbank Park. Focaccia sandwiches baked and supplied to local coffee shops.

Not a restaurant. Not a café. Real food, made properly, from a converted outhouse round the back of a house. The kind of thing you'd eat standing up and not regret.
